Olin Winchester, a business division of Olin
announced on Friday that it won a $788.4M firm-fixed-price IDIQ contract for the procurement of 5.56mm, 7.62mm and .50-caliber ammunition.
The work locations and funding are to be determined as individual orders are issued.
The contract is expected to be completed on September 10, 2031.
Army Contracting Command is the contracting activity.

title: Olin Winchester wins $788.4M U.S. Army ammunition contract
